description_en: Nṛtyeśvara Temple is located in the Khāchẽ courtyard of Khāchẽ Ṭola just south of Nāga Bāhāḥ (LAL0930). Four passageways towards the north, west, south and southeast connect the Khāchẽ courtyard with the main road and other courtyards.An inscription dated 1829 CE (NS 939 NS) states that Bhīma Bhāro built the Nṛtyeśvara Temple and that it contained three niches worshipped as Nṛtyeśvara. The local people worship Nṛtyeśvara when they start to learn music or dance, as well as before they give an artistic performance.Nṛteśvara, the main deity rests on a raised plinth which measures 87 cm x 65 cm x 75 cm.The plinth is covered in white ceramic tiles, while the floor of the shrine is made of marble mosaic. Inside the temple, on the right-hand side, is an inscribed stone pillar. The pillar measuring 24 cm x 22 cm x 125 cm supports a statue of a monkey holding an oil lamp. Thetoraṇaof the main deity has an image of Nṛtyeśvara and an image of a man playing themādaladrum. Above the main deity, on the ceiling, are two wooden canopies (ilām), in whichmaṇḍalaswith eight Bhairavas in eight directions have been engraved,and at the centre of thesemaṇḍalasis an image of Nṛtyeśvara.At the centre of the courtyard is aśikharakūṭa caityawith a rectangular stone wall that supports an oil lamp balustrade around it. A metalcãduvāabove thecaityais supported by four angular iron rods. The courtyard retains its original stone flooring and there is a well at its northeastern corner. On the way to the courtyard, on the brick wall, there are three small niches, inside which are four stones that are worshipped asGulugulu Dyaḥ.The temple measures is situated at the southeast corner of Khāchẽ courtyard.measuring 965 cm x 945 cm. The back section of the temple is attached to two houses. The temple is supported by six carved columns which are placed at irregular intervals from one another. The wooden cornice is carved in different patterns and painted in bright colours. The floor level is separated from the next level by a brick cornice. The first floor is furnished with three small blind windows flanked by carved struts. The roof structure is double-layered; the bottom roof forms a three-sided slope and is plastered with lime and painted, while the upper roof is a bell-shaped structure made ofvajraand decorated with floral patterns. The temple’s pinnacle is made of stone, painted yellow, and has a doubleãvaḥsāḥ. According to a local informant, the temple had a tiled roof and a metal pinnacle before its renovation in VS 1998.Two of the temple’s corner struts (ṭũḍāla) represent carvings of dancers. Two struts contain images of people playing themādaladrum, one strut bears an image of Gaṇeśa, and another one contains an image of Nṛtyanātha (Darnāla2000, 55).
description_ne: नृत्येश्वर मन्दिर नाग बाहाः (LAL0930) को दक्षिणी भागमा खाछेँ टोलको खाछेँ प्राङ्गणमा अवस्थित छ । उत्तर, पश्चिम, दक्षिण र दक्षिण पूर्व तिर रहेका चारवटा मार्गहरूले खाछेँ प्राङ्गणलाई मुख्य सडक र अन्य प्राङ्गणसँग जोडेका छन् । नेसं 939 (इसं १८२९) मा लेखिएको शिलालेखमा भूम भारोले नृत्येश्वर मन्दिर बनाएको कुरा उल्लेख गरिएको छ । स्थानीय मानिसहरू विशेष गरी संगीत वा नृत्य सिक्न सुरु गर्ने वेलामा  अथवा कला प्रदर्शनको अघि नृत्येश्वरको पूजा गर्न यस मन्दिरमा आउने गर्दछन् ।मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा नृत्येश्वरको प्रतिमा रहेको छ ।  प्रतिमाको माथि रहेको तोरणमा पनि  नृत्येश्वरको प्रतिमा रहेको छ ।  त्यसमाथि सिलिङ्मा काठका दुई इलाँ राखिएका छन् र दुवैमा आठ दिशामा अष्टभैरवको प्रतिमा बनाई केन्द्रमा नृत्येश्वरको प्रतिमा बनाइएको छ ।मन्दिरको आँगनको मध्यभागमा एउटा शिखरकूट चैत्य छ र उत्तरपश्चिम कुनामा एउटा  इनार छ । मन्दिरको आँगनमा प्रवेश गर्ने बाटोछेउ बनाइएको  ईट्टाको पर्खालमा तीनवटा प्रतिमास्थान छन् जसमा चारवटा ढुङ्गाका प्रतिमा छन् जसलाई गुलुगुलु द्यः भनी पूजा गरिन्छ ।मन्दिरको लम्बाई २३० सेमी, उचाइ ५५० सेमी र चौडाइ १३५ सेमी रहेको छ । छवटा कुँदिएका स्तम्भहरूले मन्दिरको माथिल्लो भागलाई अड्याएको छ । तल्लो र माथ्लो तला छुट्याउने काठको कर्निसमा विभिन्न बुट्टा कुँदिएको छ र चम्किला रङ् लगाइएको छ । मन्दिरको छानो तीनतिर भिरालो परेको छ भने माथिल्लो घण्टाकार छानामा फूलबुट्टा कुँदिएका छन् । मन्दिरका टुँडालहरूमध्ये दुईटामा नर्तकहरूको प्रतिमा छ, दुईटामा मादल बजाइरहेका मानिस छन् एउटामा गणेशको प्रतिमा छ भने अर्कोमा नृत्यनाथको प्रतिमा छ (Darnāla2000, 55) ।  स्थानीयले दिएको जानकारी अनुसार विसं १९९८ मा पुनर्निर्माण गर्नुभन्दा पहिला मन्दिरको छानो टायलले छाइएको थियो ।
references: Sources and references Sources Darnāla, Prākaśa, 2000, ‘Pātana khācheñ sthit nrityanātha mandira’, Abhilekha , 17,52-55, here p. 55.

historical_events.event_name: Constructionof a stone pillar with a statue of monkey
historical_events.event_description: Rudrasiṁha Bhāro and his family installed a stone pillar with a statue of a monkey holding an oil lamp.

There is a bell hanging on a stone beam. The bell was donated in NS 918. The stone beam retains the date NS 830. It appears that the earlier bell was donated in NS 830 and after it was broken or lost the second one was installed in NS 918.
Hari Bhāro (son of the Rudrasiṁha Bhāro) donated theśikharakūṭa caitya.
A person named Kṛṣṇa installed a bell in front of theśikharakūṭa caitya.
Donation of the embossed metaltoraṇain front of the three small holes which are worshipped as Nṛtyeśvara.
